_about: Numbers and exact statements that the condensed note (GFF/note/long_range_ising_condensed.tex, edition fa71533 of 13 October 2026) quotes in its section 'Three dimensions: half-shift determinants and rank-two functions' (label app:threeDimensionalReduction), and that the research-bundle packages lri_d3_reduction_update and lri_d3_matrix_update produce. Read by public/replay.py of both packages. 'shown' strings are the note's digits; 'eq' is the note's equation label. Written by Claude (session C63d) on 2026-10-13 for the public release; the values themselves were produced in September 2026 by the research conversation that made the bundle.

periods.eq: values listed in subsection 'Three-dimensional values and limits of the reduction'
periods.note_says: The fixed rational formulas give Q_3, P_4(3), P_5(3) (33 digits after the point shown, followed by \ldots).
periods.tolerance: one unit in the last shown digit: the note truncates or rounds after 33 decimals

spectral_residuals.note_says: Changed-precision formula evaluations and fresh Gamma-kernel integrations agreed at about 10^-51, 10^-52 and 10^-53, respectively.
spectral_residuals.definition: formula-side value at 90 working digits (verify_d3.py) minus the fresh real-axis Gamma-kernel value at 60 working digits (check_spectral.py), as recorded in verification/general_d3/comparison_summary.json

horn_nodes.note_says: Q_3 needs H_3(0); P_4(3) needs H_4(0), H_4(1/8); P_5(3) needs H_7(0), H_7(+-1/16), H_7(3/16), H_7(5/16); arguments (1,1) for r=3,4 and (-1,1) for r=7; all uncancelled parameters positive rational

gamma_amplitudes.note_says: a_3 b_3 = Gamma(1/4)^10/(16 sqrt2 pi^4) (Dixon), b_4 = Gamma(1/4)^6/(16 pi^(5/2)) (Rogers-Dougall)
gamma_amplitudes.tolerance: absolute; the recorded errors are 1.4e-79 and 5e-88 at 90 working digits

section1_table_d3.note_says: Section 1 coefficient table, column d=3 (these entries are owned by the general-d rows; listed here only as a cross-check of the record comparison_summary.json, whose assembly script is not in the package)
section1_table_d3.tolerance: rounds to the shown digits (one unit in the last shown digit)

rank_two.tolerance: exact for coefficients and counts; interior partial sums at 90 working digits within 1e-85
